entries.clue: Movement of a Mass setting that begins holy, holy, holy
Senior priest of a chapter, or a tune that chases its own tail
Prime beef joint from the back, said to be knighted by a king
Units the conductor counts, marked off down the page by upright lines
Laurel leaf for the stew pot, whose Caribbean namesake scents a rum splash.
Weekly run-through where singers learn a piece before performing it
To hang in the air long after the person wearing it has left.
Familiar name for the crisp potatoes done in the fat round the meat
Heavy with one particular smell, or richly calling a past age to mind
Left under foil a while so the juices settle before carving
Scots word for smoke, and in English to give off a powerful stench
Man's voice pitched between the highest and the lowest of the male ranges
French for water, and the first word on countless fragrance labels.
Meaty knuckle at the bottom of the leg, braised and brought to table whole
